---
title: "Accessible Observable Plot charts in Quarto"
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maidr/dist/maidr.js"></script>
          <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maidr/dist/observable.js"></script>
---

Render this file with `quarto render penguins.qmd`, open the result, and Tab to
a chart. Arrow keys move between data points, <kbd>S</kbd> toggles
sonification, <kbd>B</kbd> braille, and <kbd>T</kbd> text descriptions.

Nothing below calls MAIDR. The two scripts in the header are the whole
integration: the adapter watches the page and binds each chart as the
Observable runtime draws it.

If you have installed the extension with `quarto add xability/maidr`, replace
the `include-in-header` block above with:

``` yaml
filters:
  - maidr
```

## A bar chart

```{ojs}
// Inline so the document renders with no data file and no network. In your own
// document this is where `FileAttachment("penguins.csv").csv({typed: true})`
// or an `ojs_define()` from an R or Python chunk would go.
penguins = [
  { species: "Adelie", island: "Torgersen", flipper_length_mm: 181, body_mass_g: 3750 },
  { species: "Adelie", island: "Torgersen", flipper_length_mm: 186, body_mass_g: 3800 },
  { species: "Adelie", island: "Biscoe", flipper_length_mm: 190, body_mass_g: 3325 },
  { species: "Adelie", island: "Biscoe", flipper_length_mm: 184, body_mass_g: 3400 },
  { species: "Chinstrap", island: "Dream", flipper_length_mm: 192, body_mass_g: 3500 },
  { species: "Chinstrap", island: "Dream", flipper_length_mm: 196, body_mass_g: 3900 },
  { species: "Chinstrap", island: "Dream", flipper_length_mm: 193, body_mass_g: 3675 },
  { species: "Gentoo", island: "Biscoe", flipper_length_mm: 211, body_mass_g: 4500 },
  { species: "Gentoo", island: "Biscoe", flipper_length_mm: 230, body_mass_g: 5700 },
  { species: "Gentoo", island: "Biscoe", flipper_length_mm: 218, body_mass_g: 5200 }
]
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  title: "Mean body mass by species",
  x: { label: "Species" },
  y: { label: "Body mass (g)" },
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(penguins, Plot.groupX({ y: "mean" }, { x: "species", y: "body_mass_g" }))
  ]
})
```

## A scatter plot

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  title: "Flipper length against body mass",
  x: { label: "Flipper length (mm)" },
  y: { label: "Body mass (g)" },
  marks: [Plot.dot(penguins, { x: "flipper_length_mm", y: "body_mass_g" })]
})
```

## A reactive chart

The cell below redraws whenever the slider moves, and the adapter binds each
redraw — so the chart is still navigable after the reader has changed it.

```{ojs}
viewof minimumMass = Inputs.range([2500, 5000], { step: 100, value: 2500, label: "Minimum body mass (g)" })
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  title: `Penguins over ${minimumMass} g`,
  x: { label: "Species" },
  y: { label: "Count" },
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(
      penguins.filter(d => d.body_mass_g >= minimumMass),
      Plot.groupX({ y: "count" }, { x: "species" })
    )
  ]
})
```

## Facets become panels

Each facet is a MAIDR panel. Move between them with <kbd>Page Up</kbd> and
<kbd>Page Down</kbd>.

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  title: "Mean body mass by species and island",
  x: { label: "Species" },
  y: { label: "Body mass (g)" },
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(penguins, Plot.groupX(
      { y: "mean" },
      { x: "species", y: "body_mass_g", fx: "island" }
    ))
  ]
})
```
